                                       Resolution 2026-09
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

   Support for Transfer of HLB Parcel ID #6-057K from HLB to MOA Street Maintenance –
                                  Girdwood

   WHEREAS, Municipality of Anchorage Street Maintenance and the subset MOA Street Maintenance – Girdwood is a
    department of the Municipality of Anchorage and is able to manage municipal land; and

   WHEREAS, MOA Street Maintenance - Girdwood manages other lands within Girdwood and is funded by Girdwood
    Valley Service Area property taxes for the benefit of the community as a whole; and

   WHEREAS, Plat 2026-43 of the Girdwood Industrial Park recorded in July 2026; the plat officially identifies parcels
    within the Girdwood Industrial Park, as requested by the community of Girdwood; and

   WHEREAS, transfer of HLB Parcel ID 6-057K Parcel ID# 075-131-18 from Heritage Land Bank to MOA Street
    Maintenance - Girdwood will allow the Girdwood Valley Service Area to invest local tax funds in improvements and
     infrastructure and development that have been requested by the community, including adding power to the lot for use by
   snow removal equipment; and

   WHEREAS, request of this transfer is supported by the Girdwood Land Use Committee, by a vote of 6 in favor, 0
    opposed at their September 14 regular meeting; and

   WHEREAS, transfer of HLB Parcel 6-057K is consistent with the HLB Annual Work Plan and with the Girdwood
    Comprehensive Plan.

   THEREFORE the Girdwood Board of Supervisors resolves its support for HLB transfer of management authority of HLB
    Parcel 6-057K, Parcel ID# 075-131-18 from Heritage Land Bank to MOA Street Maintenance - Girdwood.

    Passed and approved by the Girdwood Board of Supervisors by a vote of 5 in favor and 0 opposed on this 21st day of
    September 2026.




    Jennifer Wingard                                        Attest
